distance_quartile_pattern.interpretation: There is no monotonic increase in ranking disagreement from close to distant family pairs.

interpretation: Related plant families do not show detectably more similar conservative-to-labile trait-memory rankings. The family-specific ranking architecture is therefore better described as phylogenetically mosaic than as a smoothly inherited deeper-lineage hierarchy at this resolution.
relationship_to_family_mean_context: This independently matches the earlier result that the family-wide memory context score is not associated with family patristic distance. Both the family main effect and the trait-ranking architecture lack detectable smooth deep-phylogenetic organization.
hard_nonclaims: A null distance association does not prove rankings are evolutionarily random.
This analysis does not identify the ecological or evolutionary driver of re-ranking.
This post-outcome exploratory result cannot replace the prospective AusTraits replication.
Memory-loss rho is not an evolutionary-rate estimator.
